description: This file defines the internal class NatsBatchContainer, which implements the IBatchContainer interface. It encapsulates a batch of streaming events for the Orleans framework, specifically for NATS streaming provider integration. The class includes properties for stream identification, sequence tokens, events, request context, and reply information, along with methods for importing request context and retrieving typed events.

classes.name: NatsBatchContainer
classes.description: An internal class representing a batch of streaming events for Orleans NATS provider, implementing IBatchContainer.

methods.name: ImportRequestContext
methods.description: Imports the request context into the current execution context, returning true if successful.

methods.name: GetEvents
methods.description: Retrieves events of a specified type from the batch, associating each with the sequence token.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the batch container, including stream ID and item count.
